cluster.kubectl_note: the Kubernetes client built into oc, invoked as kubectl

entries.cmd: oc adm new-project lab-batch && oc annotate namespace lab-batch scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/defaultTolerations='[{"key":"lab-dedicated","operator":"Equal","value":"batch","effect":"NoSchedule"}]' scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/tolerationsWhitelist='[{"key":"lab-dedicated","operator":"Equal","value":"batch","effect":"NoSchedule"}]' && oc adm policy add-role-to-user edit developer -n lab-batch
